steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Milky Way is a barred spiral galaxy approximately 100,000 light-years in diameter

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: It contains 100–400 billion stars, gas, dust and dark matter

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The structure includes a central bar and bulge, a flat disc with spiral arms, and a spherical halo of globular clusters

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Sun is located about 26,000 light-years from the galactic centre in the Orion Arm

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Q: What type of galaxy is the Milky Way? | Q: Where is the Sun located in the Milky Way? | Q: What is Sagittarius A*?

steps.title: Check your answers
steps.body: A barred spiral galaxy with a central bar, spiral arms, a bulge and a halo. | About 26,000 light-years from the galactic centre, in the Orion Arm (a minor spiral arm). | The supermassive black hole at the centre of the Milky Way, with a mass of about 4 million solar masses.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: The Milky Way is a BARRED spiral — not just a spiral (this was confirmed in 2005) Sagittarius A* is pronounced 'Sagittarius A-star' The Sun is in the Orion Arm — know this location Both boards test the structure of the Milky Way in detail
